scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && poetry run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && poetry run arq app.workers.job_worker.WorkerSettings
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && poetry run pytest tests/ -q --tb=short --cov=app
scripts.lint: eslint . && cd apps/api && poetry run ruff check app/
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cd apps/api && poetry run ruff format app/
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && cd apps/web && pnpm tsc --noEmit && cd ../mobile && pnpm tsc --noEmit
